01The destination matches
production in real time.

Every insert, update and delete lands within a minute of commit, one row per record. History mode keeps every change when you want it.

02Production doesn't
slow down.

Artie reads the transaction log, not your tables. Backfills don't block writes.

03Enterprise reliability
from your first deploy.

A first pipeline is the easy part. Schema evolution, fan-in, exactly-once delivery at scale and failure recovery take most teams one to two years to build. Artie ships with all of it.

Built for the data stack
you already run.

Stream from Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB and more into Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks and the rest of your stack.

See all connectors

From PostgreSQL to Snowflake

Get your data streaming in 3 steps

  1. 1

    Connect your source

    Point Artie at Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB or another database you already run.

  2. 2

    Choose tables to replicate

    Pick the tables and columns you need, mask sensitive fields before they leave production, and keep every change with SCD Type 2 history.

  3. 3

    Deploy and stream

    Changes land within a minute with exactly-once delivery, and schema changes carry over on their own.

We never store your data.

Artie is built so we never store your data. We read from your replication log and stream to your destination. Credentials are encrypted at rest, and data is encrypted end to end.
